characters.name: Water-sect burn patient

characters.description: The leader of the Order of the Celestial Flame summons Sen after observing him teach the Order's young sword students. She recognizes him as Judgment's Gale and requests a private audience.
characters.name: Order of the Celestial Flame matriarch

characters.description: The Order matriarch's white-haired daughter is the healer who sought Sen's instruction after the battlefield. Her connection to the Order places her earlier interest in his alchemy within the fire leader's household.
characters.name: Order matriarch's daughter

characters.description: Falling Leaf reacts strongly when Sen reports meeting someone known as Boulder's Shadow, showing unexplained prior knowledge of that identity.
characters.name: Boulder's Shadow

characters.description: A reluctant cultivator sent by the Order matriarch joins Sen in exchange for Sen receiving an exceptionally powerful spear. Sen accepts him only after making clear that he must contribute to the dangerous journey ahead.
characters.name: New travelling companion

characters.description: A careful prince of the Zhang family has built wealth and influence with help from a household diviner. After learning that Judgment's Gale will enter his region, he considers whether to seek a cautious alliance.
characters.name: Zhang-family prince

characters.description: An ancient cultivator who advises a Zhang-family prince, this diviner has repeatedly aided his patron with limited predictions. He foresees Judgment's Gale as a fate-changing opportunity that could also bring ruin.
characters.name: Noble's household diviner

recaps.ending: Sen leaves the Order of the Celestial Flame for the capital, where he hopes to find the manual needed to continue the five-fold body transformation without dying. Falling Leaf accompanies him in her apparently permanent human form, along with Feng's watcher and a reluctant cultivator assigned by the Order matriarch. Sen still employs the watcher because she is a familiar risk, but their friendship remains broken after her manipulation in Inferno's Vale. Feng Ming, Kho Jaw-Long, and Caihong remain part of his support network, while Caihong accepts responsibility for rescuing the younger companion from the Temple of Eternity's Edge. Sen's heavenly-shadow core and altered Heaven's Rebuke remain dangerous mysteries. The Ghost Panther question is also unresolved, with Falling Leaf hoping to find Boulder's Shadow or others of her kind. Before Sen arrives, a household diviner warns a Zhang-family prince that Judgment's Gale could transform his fortunes or destroy them, prompting the prince to consider an alliance.
recaps.in_short: Fleeing demonic cultivators, Sen survives a qi-shaped storm, undergoes the five-fold body transformation, and is forced into core formation with a strange heavenly-shadow core. His party is captured at the Temple of Eternity's Edge, where he devises a new cultivation method and escapes with Feng's watcher, while his younger companion remains behind. At Inferno's Vale, Sen ends a sect war through heavenly oaths and treats wounded cultivators from both sides, but learns that his watcher manipulated him into the conflict to reach her brother. Feng Ming, Kho Jaw-Long, Caihong, and a permanently human-shaped Falling Leaf reunite with him. Needing a manual before his body cultivation advances again, Sen departs for the capital with Falling Leaf, the distrusted watcher, and a new reluctant companion. A diviner has already warned a Zhang-family prince that Judgment's Gale is coming.

recaps.text: Previously: Sen became the independent disciple of Feng Ming and also trained under Kho Jaw-Long and Caihong. These three nascent-soul cultivators form a powerful mountain family around him, teaching him cultivation, spear combat, and alchemy. Falling Leaf, a Ghost Panther, became one of his closest companions. Sen's actions also brought him into conflict with demonic cultivators, leaving him and his companions under continuing threat as this volume begins.

So far this book: While fleeing by ship, Sen detects foreign qi driving a destructive storm toward the vessel. He protects the entire ship inside a hardened shell of water, but the effort severely injures him. During his recovery, he discovers an unexplained ribbon of qi circling his dantian. On a nearby beach, an ancient divine turtle adds rare ingredients to Sen's healing elixir. The resulting transformation rebuilds his body and completes a five-fold body transformation. The advancement immediately draws heavenly lightning. Sen survives his first tribulation by combining earth defenses, his spear, and liquid qi, though he is left burned and exhausted. The turtle asks him to return after reaching core formation, while the exact stage and consequences of his new body cultivation remain unclear.

So far this book: Sen recovers from his body transformation and begins training his younger qi-condensation companion in combat. The party leaves the repaired ship at Tide's Rest and travels overland under concealment. When Feng's watcher returns to the city to report and does not come back by sunset, Sen follows her instructions and flees with his student. He slows their pace for her, hides their trail, and builds concealed camps while refusing an unsupported rescue attempt. A powerful spiritual sense later sweeps the region without penetrating Sen's defenses. During a brief hidden rest, Sen examines his own anger, impulsiveness, and dependence on others. He resolves to exercise greater discipline and accepts that killing may sometimes be necessary to protect himself or another person. His younger companion also confirms that Judgment's Gale is an epithet associated with him.

So far this book: Feng's watcher survives the city ambush, kills the cultivators pursuing her, and tracks Sen's route while eliminating additional searchers. She rejoins Sen and his younger companion outside Heaven's Virtue, and the three agree to share information relevant to their safety. A pull on Sen's soul leads them west, even as the strange ribbon in his dantian makes him postpone core formation. Their concealed camp is then attacked by demonic cultivators sent specifically for Sen. Formations and killing intent let Sen turn the ambush, and the watcher invokes his ties to Feng Ming, Kho Jaw-Long, and Caihong. When Sen releases Heaven's Rebuke, the anomalous qi alters the technique, destroys the enemy leader's core, and kills him. Sen realizes that such a power would make him a target for core cultivators everywhere, so both companions swear binding heavenly oaths to keep it secret.

So far this book: Elsewhere, Falling Leaf learns to live in a human body so she can seek Sen, while Feng Ming and Kho Jaw-Long attack demonic cultivators connected to Sen's intelligence. Sen's group abandons the road for the wilds after deciding that repeated ambushes are the greater danger. Sen has enough liquid qi to attempt core formation but wants to delay it until the party can prepare. A massive influx of heavenly qi makes that impossible. He shares a safe portion with his companions and tries to contain the rest, but the energy forces his breakthrough. Heavenly qi and shadow qi merge into a liquid gray substance that hardens his new core. Sen names this energy heavenly shadow. He emerges as a core-formation cultivator, but his dantian is nearly empty and his former cultivation method can no longer replenish it effectively.

So far this book: Sen wakes after several days of core formation to find his companions trapped in a battle involving spirit beasts and demonic cultivators. With help from protective spirit oxen, the party defeats the immediate enemies and withdraws. Sen begins testing new cultivation manuals because his old method no longer suits his core. Continued travel brings attacks, infection, and the attention of a nascent soul-level dragon, though Sen suspects an unseen influence may also be discouraging some spirit beasts. A persistent inner pull leads the group to a buried road and southward into the deep wilds. When they finally decide the destination is too dangerous and try to turn back, an elderly cultivator appears. He overwhelms all three travelers and forces them to the Temple of Eternity's Edge, warning that nearly everyone who enters remains there.

So far this book: The leader of the Temple of Eternity's Edge defeats Sen's resistance, confiscates the party's belongings, and imprisons each traveler separately. Sen refuses recruitment and uses his long isolation to experiment with multiple parallel qi flows. In a deep inner trance, he develops a four-path system that can sustain his core and produce core-level qi without overwhelming his mind. After waking, Sen invokes Feng Ming, Kho Jaw-Long, and Caihong, and heavenly thunder helps force the return of his possessions. He secures the release of Feng's watcher, but their younger companion has adopted temple robes and refuses to leave. Sen believes the leader's gray energy has influenced her, although her fear and resentment are real. He destroys nine statues controlling the temple formation and escapes with the watcher, warning the leader that he will return if the harmful influence remains.

So far this book: Sen and Feng's watcher evade pursuit while she recovers from drugged temple food and sustained recruitment pressure. They agree to return against the temple leader once they are strong enough. The watcher chooses to remain with Sen even when he offers to request a replacement, and the pair enter Lin Wen's Redoubt to report their survival through Feng Ming's network. Their local contact betrays their arrival to a merchant and is killed. The merchant then traps them with crossbowmen inside a flawed qi-suppression formation, intending to sell Sen to a merchant prince from the capital. Sen collapses the formation, and the pair defeat the ambush. They spare the merchant after concluding that an unknown party sabotaged her plan in hopes of killing everyone involved. Sen and the watcher continue toward Inferno's Vale, now treating it as a place to train rather than merely hide.

So far this book: At Inferno's Vale, Sen and his watcher find fire and water cultivators fighting a major battle. She reveals that her estranged brother is among the fire cultivators, and Sen agrees to help locate him. After intervening for a trapped fire patrol, Sen regrets choosing a side without understanding the feud, but continues toward the fire compound. A water-side swordswoman challenges him to a formal duel. Sen defeats her and treats her wounds, then publicly accepts the identity Judgment's Gale. He raises a storm of fire, shadow, and lightning and threatens to end the battle himself. Both commanders surrender their weapons. Sen orders the armies to collect their wounded and withdraw, then compels the commanders to swear heavenly oaths preventing renewed attacks between their sects. The organized conflict ends under his temporary authority.

So far this book: Sen remains neutral while supervising the battlefield cleanup with the water-side swordswoman. He produces healing elixirs for both forces and spends days treating their most severe casualties. His success makes his alchemical skill widely known, and healers begin competing to study under him. After the water cultivators recover enough to leave, their swordswoman invites him to visit and they acknowledge mutual interest without making a commitment. Sen then confronts Feng's watcher. She admits that she concealed her brother's presence and deliberately relied on Sen's character and abilities to draw him into the battle. She believes the outcome justified the choice for everyone except Sen. He accepts responsibility for choosing to fight but tells her that the manipulation destroyed his trust. Their working arrangement continues, while their friendship remains broken.

So far this book: The Order of the Celestial Flame's matriarch summons Sen after seeing him teach young sword students. She explains that an outsider could end the generational feud without causing the internal fracture that direct intervention might have produced. Although the commanders' oaths do not formally bind the sect leaders, renewed war is now unlikely. In exchange for Sen's help, the matriarch identifies possible holders of the five-fold body-transformation manual and promises him a weapon. Her white-haired daughter seeks alchemy instruction, but Sen refuses because he judges her unwilling to learn. Kho Jaw-Long then arrives, followed by Feng Ming, Caihong, and a young woman who embraces Sen and identifies herself as Falling Leaf. Sen takes the reunion outside the compound and builds a concealed stone house so Falling Leaf's human-passing form can remain secret while the group exchanges accounts.

So far this book: Sen demonstrates Heaven's Rebuke and explains how an autonomous qi ribbon once changed it into a core-destroying attack. Feng Ming, Kho Jaw-Long, and Caihong cannot explain the phenomenon and regard further testing as dangerous. They also confirm that the five-fold body transformation is exceptionally rare and frequently fatal. Falling Leaf explains that her human transformation was undertaken to reach and protect Sen and is apparently irreversible. She chooses to travel with him and hopes eventually to find Boulder's Shadow or other surviving Ghost Panthers. Sen makes obtaining the body-cultivation manual his immediate priority and chooses the capital as the next destination. Caihong accepts responsibility for the younger companion still at the temple. Sen retains Feng's watcher as a known risk despite their broken trust. The Order matriarch gives Sen a powerful spear on condition that he accept a reluctant cultivator as another companion. Sen departs with Falling Leaf, the watcher, and the new traveler.

Sen has left for the capital to seek the manual required for the next stage of his five-fold body cultivation. Falling Leaf travels beside him in a human form she does not believe she can reverse. Feng's watcher remains in the party because Sen considers her more manageable than an unknown replacement, although he no longer trusts her. The Order matriarch's reluctant appointee completes the traveling group, bound to the arrangement by the spear Sen accepted. Behind them, Feng Ming, Kho Jaw-Long, and Caihong remain available as powerful allies, and Caihong has taken responsibility for the younger companion still inside the Temple of Eternity's Edge. Sen's heavenly-shadow core and altered Heaven's Rebuke remain unexplained. In the capital's political sphere, an ancient household diviner tells a Zhang-family prince that Judgment's Gale will enter his region and could redirect his fate. The prince decides to consult his wife before choosing whether to seek an alliance with Sen.

characters.description: A formidable core-formation cultivator travelling toward the capital while hostile cultivators pursue him. He protects his companions with overwhelming force and regards the journey as a return to the dangerous world he had briefly escaped.
characters.name: Sen

characters.name: Liu Ai

characters.name: Spider companion

characters.name: Glimmer of Night

characters.description: A cultivator accompanying Sen toward the capital. She understands that both Sen and his spider companion far exceed her strength, but remains with them while pursuit makes the journey increasingly dangerous.
characters.name: Travelling companion

characters.description: The name of Sen's travelling companion, learned as reports about his academy reach the party. She is important to Sen's household and has accompanied him despite the repeated attacks on the road to the capital.
characters.name: Shen Mingxia

characters.name: Long Jia Wei

characters.description: The ruler whose relationship with Sen may suffer if hostile cultivators delay Sen's journey to the capital.
characters.name: The king

characters.description: A high-level ally who learns that Sen has returned publicly and acquired a noble house. She remains personally interested in him and is concerned about the political consequences of his new position.
characters.name: Lo Meifeng

characters.description: A sect matriarch who arrives at the royal gathering and openly treats Sen as her lover. Her presence confirms their intimacy before the assembled court and places two exceptionally powerful cultivators at the center of attention.
characters.name: Lai Dongmei

characters.description: A foreign ambassador whose royal status becomes clear at the capital gathering. She was sent abroad after resisting politically useful marriages and studies Sen as an unusual and potentially important cultivator.
characters.name: Foreign princess and ambassador

characters.description: The woman who raised Sen and whom he regards as his grandmother. She arrives at his newly fortified manor to assume practical responsibility for the noble house he has acquired and to give it experienced family leadership.
characters.name: Sen's grandmother

characters.description: A former servant of the defeated noble house who chooses to swear personal loyalty and service directly to Sen. Her oath distinguishes her from staff who bind themselves only to his new house.
characters.name: Capital steward

characters.description: A trusted mortal attendant of the king who comes to House of Lu to ask when Sen's reprisals will end. Although she understands that he once intended to help her, she fears him because his qi altered her panic without her consent.
characters.name: Royal attendant

characters.description: A cultivator identified as an intermediary in the plot to bomb Sen's manor. She is linked to arranging the attack before the people who supplied the explosive and breached the defenses are fully identified.
characters.name: Attack intermediary

characters.description: An exceptionally skilled cultivator recruited on short notice to teach weapons at Sen's academy. He can strike several airborne targets with a bow and retrieve his arrows using wind qi, but his heavy reliance on alcohol makes his reliability uncertain.
characters.name: Core-formation archer

characters.description: A returning mentor who reaches Deep Wilds Academy while Sen is away. Feng Ming studies its unexpected weapons training for mortal men and women, notices rudimentary cultivation-like practices among the students, and waits to learn Sen's purpose.
characters.name: Feng Ming

characters.description: A powerful cultivator allied with Sen and part of his extended household. He is known before this volume as one of Sen's teachers and remains a trusted elder connected to Liu Ai and the academy.
characters.name: Feng

characters.description: A trusted elder and alchemical expert in Sen's household. She helps protect Liu Ai while Sen is away and remains part of the close family circle to which he hopes to return.
characters.name: Caihong

characters.description: A trusted elder in Sen's household and one of his teachers. Kho helps protect Liu Ai during Sen's journey, and Sen continues to draw on techniques learned from him when facing powerful cultivators.
characters.name: Kho

characters.description: A spirit beast who belongs to Sen's close household and helps protect Liu Ai. Falling Leaf is among the family members Sen longs to keep safe, while the obstruction affecting her Ghost Panther form remains unresolved.
characters.name: Falling Leaf

characters.description: An ancient nine-tailed fox tied to Sen's household by an outstanding debt. Laughing River's ascension, his campaign involving other foxes, and his knowledge of Falling Leaf's blocked spirit-beast form remain unresolved at the start of this volume.
characters.name: Laughing River

characters.description: A returning acquaintance of Sen who is known for protecting people in danger. Sen encounters him defending a distressed young woman from cultivators and recognizes him as someone who keeps his word.
characters.name: Righteous cultivator

characters.description: The leader of the noble house that Sen links to the assassination attempt against him. Sen confronts the leader publicly in the royal throne room and announces that he has business with the house.
characters.name: Assassination-linked house leader

characters.description: A foreign ambassador who threatens Shen Mingxia during the royal gathering. Sen detects the coercion and intervenes against him in view of the assembled court.
characters.name: Threatening foreign ambassador

characters.description: The patriarch of a rival noble house whose involvement in the bombing of Sen's manor is confirmed by intelligence gathered in the capital. Sen selects him as the next target of a limited reprisal.
characters.name: Rival patriarch

recaps.ending: Sen leaves House of Lu in the capital under his grandmother's management, with Lo Meifeng directing intelligence and security work and the capital steward handling administration. The direct bombing perpetrators are dead, but the escaped demonic cultivators, the formation breach, and the fate of the captured intermediary remain unresolved. The king continues investigating the sabotage of the palace walls. Sen takes Long Jia Wei, displaced children, educators, and weapons instructors north, while the royal attendant is also expected to pursue cultivation under his guidance. He leaves the caravan shortly before it reaches Deep Wilds Academy and reunites with Liu Ai, Caihong, Kho, Falling Leaf, and Feng. Glimmer of Night stays with the caravan for its last leg. Sen still conceals the manor's resource lair, rare manuals, and his superior explosive formula. The incoming children require separate housing and supervision, and House of Lu's political future remains unsettled. Feng provides the immediate handoff by reporting that he has discovered the cause of the spirit-beast disturbance, but the explanation has not yet been given.
recaps.in_short: Sen fights through repeated attacks on the road to the capital, kills a nascent-soul leader, and arrives publicly as Judgment's Gale. To secure Liu Ai's future, he destroys the noble house behind the assassination attempt and converts its assets into House of Lu. He fortifies its manor, discovers a hidden cultivator lair, recruits Lo Meifeng and his grandmother to run the new organization, supports the king, and refuses a foreign princess's request to help seize her father's throne. A mortal explosive then bypasses the manor defenses and kills staff. Sen traces the delivery to a rival house and demonic cultivators, exacts public vengeance, and keeps a stronger explosive formula secret, but some culprits escape. He relocates the defeated house's children and recruits staff for his academy before returning north. Sen reunites with Liu Ai and his household while the caravan remains close behind. Feng then reveals that he has found the cause of the unresolved spirit-beast crisis.

recaps.text: Previously: Sen founded Deep Wilds Academy and built a household around Liu Ai, the young girl he adopted as his daughter. Caihong and Kho are trusted elders who help protect her, while Falling Leaf is a spirit-beast companion with an obstructed Ghost Panther form. Feng is one of Sen's powerful teachers and remains tied to this extended family. Sen also carries an unresolved connection to Laughing River, an ancient nine-tailed fox who owes him a debt. The academy and household offer Sen a quieter purpose, but his growing cultivation strength and his reputation as Judgment's Gale keep drawing him back into wider conflicts. His concern for Liu Ai's future now shapes his choices, especially because his advancement may eventually separate him from mortal life. Questions surrounding spirit beasts remain unsettled, including Falling Leaf's blocked transformation and Laughing River's own affairs. At the opening of this volume, Sen must leave the relative safety of home and travel toward the capital while Caihong, Kho, and Falling Leaf remain with Liu Ai.

Sen travels toward the capital with an unnamed cultivator companion and a powerful spider spirit beast, avoiding roads because cultivators are searching for him. He aids vulnerable travellers but kills bandits and anyone who threatens those under his protection. Several pursuit groups attack. Sen destroys their leaders with lightning and sword work, while the spider independently hunts another group with qi webs. Long Jia Wei, a former sect cultivator who surrendered to protect his juniors, is allowed to accompany the party under conditional protection. In a town, Sen reunites with a righteous cultivator whose years of practical service have earned him a heroic reputation. The traveller reports that outsiders call Sen's academy a sect, including the Blue Demon sect, despite Sen's insistence that it is an academy. Sen briefly considers abandoning his obligations and returning to Liu Ai and the rest of his household. Instead, he accepts that an earlier promise and the need to secure teachers for the academy require him to continue. He releases the righteous cultivator from every debt and oath previously owed to him.

The righteous cultivator chooses to continue with Sen even after being freed, because the old command to live without regret had become his life's purpose. Near the capital, the party discovers a large prepared ambush led by a nascent-soul cultivator. Sen orders the spider companion to protect Shen Mingxia, Long Jia Wei, and the mortal ally while he confronts the leader. He kills much of the hidden force with killing intent and qi attacks, then fights the leader directly despite the gap between their cultivation stages. Both combatants are badly hurt. When the leader threatens Sen's companions, academy, town, and daughter, Sen releases an overwhelming power that freezes the remaining enemies in fear. Glimmer of Night, the spider companion's revealed name, drains the immobilized attackers with a selective web. Sen prevents the leader from escaping, cripples him with Heaven's Rebuke, and executes him using lightning infused with divine qi. He then destroys the remaining force and extinguishes the resulting fires. The organized assassination attempt ends with Sen injured and depleted, but unmistakably victorious over an opponent who should have outclassed him.

After the battle, Sen treats his party's injuries and completes the journey without another attack. Shen Mingxia acknowledges that witnessing him kill a nascent-soul cultivator has permanently changed their friendship. Royal guards meet the group at the capital and publicly escort Judgment's Gale through the city, ensuring that nobles, sects, and foreign visitors all know he has arrived. The king provides a guarded inn, while Sen sends Long Jia Wei to gather intelligence and goes to the palace. In the throne room, Sen openly confronts the leader of the noble house linked to the assassination. He privately tells the king that he intends to destroy that house. The king wants Sen to remain in the capital as an unpredictable deterrent against dangerous foreign cultivators. Sen agrees only after turning the bargain toward Liu Ai's long-term security. He proposes replacing the condemned house with a hereditary house under his own control, built to support his adopted daughter even after he can no longer remain beside her. The king accepts. Sen will eliminate the assassination plotters but spare children and ordinary staff, while the defeated house's titles, property, and operations pass to his new house.

Sen attacks the implicated noble manor after its leader admits that the assassination was part of a plan to weaken the king and seize the throne. He defeats the guards, spares the children, and has the royal decree read to the assembled household. The old house is dissolved and its property becomes Sen's new House of Lu. Long Jia Wei executes identified conspirators, while Sen kills the former leader and any adults whose required heavenly vows fail. Surviving adults lose their wealth and status but may seek employment if they have useful skills. A young servant swears herself directly to Sen and becomes a trusted administrative retainer. Sen retains willing staff, provides for the families of dead guards, and begins taking responsibility for the displaced children. He then rebuilds the manor walls and creates interlocking formations inspired partly by Glimmer of Night's webs. The result is a formidable defense that attracts a public audience. During a search of hidden spaces, Sen and Long Jia Wei discover an intact underground cultivator lair filled with manuals, formations, alchemical supplies, rare plants, and wealth. Sen regards discovery of the cache as a grave security risk and binds Long Jia Wei to secrecy with a heaven-accepted vow.

House of Lu's fortified manor changes how nobles and sects judge Sen. Lo Meifeng confronts him for excluding her from his plans, then joins him as the strategic adviser needed to build security, intelligence, and control over distant holdings. Sen explains that the house exists to protect Liu Ai after his eventual ascension and considers developing Deep Wilds Academy into a true sect for the same purpose. He can already advance to nascent soul but delays because he wants more time with his daughter. At a royal gathering, Sen attends with Shen Mingxia, meets a foreign ambassador, and decisively subdues another ambassador who threatens his companion. Lai Dongmei arrives, publicly treats Sen as her lover, and identifies the first ambassador as a princess. Sen's power and his friendship with the king become obvious to the court. Lai Dongmei later warns that a cultivator-led noble house may encourage other cultivators to seize mortal political power. Sen accepts a duty to oppose such abuses. Returning to his manor, he retrieves Glimmer of Night and welcomes the woman who raised him. His grandmother arrives to take practical control of House of Lu and give its growing operations experienced leadership.

Sen installs his grandmother as House of Lu's manager while remaining its public head. The house has extensive wealth from his investments, but its expanding estates and planned sect require administration, hired cultivators, mortal guards, and an intelligence network. His grandmother recognizes Lo Meifeng as the household's spy and Long Jia Wei as its killer, while accepting Glimmer of Night as a trustworthy member of the family structure. The manor's strength creates a political problem because observers read its defenses as a possible challenge to the throne. Sen and the king answer by having Sen rebuild the royal palace walls, making his loyalty visible. During the work, Sen discovers that long sections of the old walls were deliberately hollowed and their formations damaged. He replaces them with higher, thicker walls, reinforcement and qi-gathering formations, and metal spikes carrying traces of divine qi. The new defenses make interference dangerous and conspicuous. Sen estimates that the sabotage occurred within the previous decade, but cannot identify who performed it or why. The king commits to a discreet investigation, leaving the weakened-wall plot unresolved even though the immediate structural danger has been repaired.

The foreign princess seeks a private alliance with Sen and asks him to leave the capital with her. At a secluded spirit-ox herd, she admits that she wants to overthrow her father and rule in his place. Sen refuses because her program would expand freedom for cultivators while preserving mortal subjugation. He forces her to confront the fear her ruling class creates, then rejects slaughter as a solution and sends her away without his help. Rumors about their excursion create diplomatic and romantic complications that Lo Meifeng and Sen's grandmother must manage. At Deep Wilds Academy, Feng Ming arrives, meets Liu Ai, and observes that the school trains mortal men and women in weapons while some students are developing rudimentary cultivation-like practices. In the capital, Sen accepts that hired sects are necessary to secure House of Lu's distant property and begins reconsidering some of his blanket hostility toward sects. Before he can return north, an explosion tears through the manor courtyard. It carries no detectable qi and bypasses every formation, killing and maiming mortal staff. Sen organizes rescue and treatment, attempts to restore lost limbs and eyes, and orders Lo Meifeng to find everyone responsible for the attack.

The manor survivors explain that the bomb arrived as a food delivery using a stolen access talisman. Long Jia Wei identifies the explosive as a mixture made through mortal alchemy, revealing both a defense flaw and a weapon that produces no qi warning. The severely wounded staff swear personal allegiance to Sen after his emergency healing, deepening his sense of responsibility for them. Lo Meifeng's investigation captures the talisman thief, and a noble matriarch supplies intelligence linking a rival patriarch to the attack. Sen limits his response to the responsible people instead of destroying another entire house. He overcomes the rival manor's guards, poison, and crossbow trap, then forces the patriarch to confess that his house delivered the explosive while others supplied the bomb and the method for bypassing the formations. A captured foundation-formation intermediary links the wider plot to earlier attacks. Meanwhile, the king sends a trusted royal attendant to ask when Sen's reprisals will end. She explains that she fears Sen because he once altered her panic without consent. Sen apologizes and swears a heavenly oath that he cannot impose complex emotions. As restitution, she asks him to make her a cultivator and accepts a dangerous, experimental process that requires leaving royal service and travelling north with him.

Sen studies the bombing mixture and develops a far stronger non-qi explosive. He decides that spreading the formula would endanger mortals and destabilize warfare, so he hides the superior version even from his teachers while retaining it as an emergency weapon. He uses lesser explosives in a deliberately public campaign against the captured bombers. With his grandmother present to demonstrate House unity, Sen executes the man who lit the fuse and allows the manor community to kill other direct participants. He then stages a second execution outside the manor for witnesses from the palace, sects, and noble houses, turning the reprisals into a deterrent. The captured intermediary says surviving demonic cultivators used her after she pursued someone who had previously betrayed her. Those targets have escaped, and she cannot identify the demonic cultivator. Sen leaves her survival and possible employment to Lo Meifeng. With the direct campaign complete, he prepares to leave the capital. The defeated house's children will travel north, lose their noble privileges, and receive civilian education rather than military training. Sen's grandmother arranges their transport and supplies while Sen plans new instructors, formation work, and funding for the academy.

Before departure, Sen collects custom formation flags and fulfills a promise by preparing tailored advancement elixirs for their makers. He auctions natural treasures to fund House of Lu, hires basic educators, and recruits weapons instructors for Deep Wilds Academy. Among them is a highly skilled core-formation archer whose long life, accumulated grief, and dependence on alcohol make him an uncertain choice. The archer begins the journey sober and treats teaching as a possible new purpose. Sen also accepts a woman recommended through Lo Meifeng only after binding vows make her compliance enforceable. The displaced noble children receive one final evening with their parents before being placed in the caravan. Sen departs with the children, educators, guards, weapons staff, Long Jia Wei, Shen Mingxia, and Glimmer of Night. Lo Meifeng, Sen's grandmother, and the capital steward remain behind with delegated authority over House of Lu. The house survives as a wealthy and fortified political force, but the escaped demonic attackers and the unknown source of the manor-defense breach remain unresolved. Sen's departure ends his immediate capital campaign and shifts responsibility toward the academy's expansion in the north.

Sen accelerates the caravan with qi and imposes strict work rules on the displaced children. He plans to house them separately and permanently deny them cultivation and weapons training because he considers them a future danger to Liu Ai. Long Jia Wei supports the policy and helps enforce it when an older boy organizes resistance. Some children remain openly resentful, though one young girl begins trusting Sen after he patiently helps her approach the caravan's oxen. The core-formation archer stays sober and proves useful by detecting an ambush. Sen kills the waiting bandits and hides the aftermath from the children. Near Deep Wilds Academy, Long Jia Wei persuades Sen to leave the caravan in the hands of its other defenders. Glimmer of Night stays with the wagons for the final leg and claims one as his own. Sen carries selected treasures and keeps the hidden lair's manual and resources secret from the unfamiliar travellers. He reaches home first and reunites with Liu Ai, Caihong, Kho, Falling Leaf, and Feng. The caravan and its new staff are still approaching, so housing and integration remain unfinished. Feng then tells Sen that he has identified the cause of the spirit-beast disturbance, but does not yet explain it.
